page.title: Agent UI protocols: a one-page comparison
page.body:
## Summary
AG-UI, MCP and A2A solve different hops of an agent system, so most teams will use more than one.

## At a glance
- **AG-UI** (agent to user): streams text, tool calls, state and interrupts to the frontend.
- **MCP** (agent to tools): discovers and calls tools and resources.
- **A2A** (agent to agent): delegates work between independent agents.

## Recommendation
Use MCP for tools, AG-UI for the human-facing stream, and add A2A only when separate agents need to hand off work.
